scripts.serve: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; node update-server.js & npx serve .
scripts.serve-dual: if lsof -i :3000 -i :3001 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Ports 3000/3001 are already in use — stop whatever is using them first (lsof -i :3000 -i :3001)'; exit 1; fi; trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; node update-server.js & npx serve . & sleep 2; open -na 'Google Chrome' --args --new-window 'http://localhost:3000/'; open -na 'Google Chrome' --args --new-window 'http://localhost:3000/?dual=1'; open -na 'Google Chrome' --args --new-window 'http://localhost:3000/?screen=2'; wait
